description: Attendant physician of the palace medical office. Forties, good robe, a carriage with a proper team and a driver who waits. Writes everything down in a fine small hand and signs with two strokes and a hook.
knows: that Geng Su died of his chest in spite of the western resin
what the resin has done to the body over six weeks, in daily slips
last_seen: arriving at the Geng gate by carriage at dusk on the sixth day
name: Du Heng
not_knows: that Xu Ping has been inside the Geng house and read the slips
owes_owed: pays the Geng house's debts and the musk, for the use of Geng Su's body until the son comes
voice: Asks questions he already knows the answers to, to watch how people answer them.
